Disposable workflow fixtures\\nAll records are synthetic test inputs, not actual service observations. Copy files into each case-owned directory before changing them. Source modules intentionally contain simple defects for reproduction. Real external services and live account writes are forbidden. No workers, traces or method receipts are predeclared successful. Capture those from actual host operations. If a prerequisite is absent, record it instead of inventing it.\\n# Investigation\\n\\nYou own the answer. Plan, route, write.\\n\\nInvestigation requests are read-only. They produce a cited explanation or a recommendation, not a code change. Read the complete [poteto mode](../SKILL.md) and this playbook before applying it. Preserve its Investigation routing for how, why, are-we-sure and choice-between-alternatives questions.\\n\\nBefore source reads or delegation, discover [session capabilities](../../../references/host-capabilities.md) and follow [model roles](../../../references/model-roles.md) and the [assignment contract](../../../references/orchestration-contract.md). Use only exposed, authorized read operations. Inherit parent model and effort unless a supported explicit selection is observed. Requested models are not observed models. The routed skills own their prompt and source contracts; this playbook directly invokes no script helper.\\n\\n1. Route through the [how skill](../../how/SKILL.md). For motivation questions, also route through the [why skill](../../why/SKILL.md). Read their complete instructions and the prompts and source playbooks required by the chosen route. Keep every investigator and explainer read-only, including connector-backed reads. Inspect delegated findings before relying on them. If independent workers are unavailable or unauthorized, disclose reduced capability and apply the same roles sequentially. Name inaccessible, denied, failed and searched-empty sources separately. Limit the answer to inspected evidence. Missing required companions or no authorized relevant source reads blocks the dependent answer.\\n2. Throughput checkpoint stays one line: `throughput checkpoint: n/a, read-only investigation`.\\n3. Produce the how-shaped output, Overview / Key Concepts / How It Works / Where Things Live / Gotchas, omitting sections only as how permits. For a decision between alternatives, produce a recommendation with a tradeoffs table. For motivation, preserve why confidence tiers, source coverage, contradictions and unknowns within the investigation output. Cite actual inspected sources. Accessible sources that support the answer are enough to deliver it without starting a product build or prototype.\\n4. Apply the [unslop skill](../../unslop/SKILL.md) to the reply.\\n\\nNo PR, no babysit, no [architect](../../architect/SKILL.md) unless the investigation precedes a code change. If it does, hand back to the user and re-route to [Bug fix](bug-fix.md) or [Feature](feature.md). That handoff does not authorize implementation, commits, PR creation or other writes. The Investigation exception takes precedence over the mode index generic Opening a PR rule. Do not install tools, change credentials or modify source state to obtain evidence.\\n\\nReply with the investigation output. For are-we-sure answers, include your real judgment with reasons. Push back if the premise is wrong under the mode Autonomy rules. Broad autonomy never overrides user authorization or host permissions. Disclose unperformed reads, uncertain conclusions and reduced roles; structural checks establish no runtime behavior or independent-worker success.\\n### Bug fix\\n\\n**You own this task. Plan, review, verify.** Delegate investigation and the fix to subagents, stay in the lead. Read the complete [mode](../SKILL.md), applied principle leaves and routed skills. Record these six steps before task-specific todos.\\n\\nUse [session capabilities](../../../references/host-capabilities.md), [model roles](../../../references/model-roles.md) and the [assignment contract](../../../references/orchestration-contract.md). Supply the complete [poteto role prompt](../../../references/agent-prompts/poteto-agent.md) to ad-hoc investigators and code delegates; routed skills retain their own roles. Assign exact input revisions, scopes, ownership and success criteria. Inspect artifacts and review the diff yourself. Missing independent workers allow authorized sequential work only as reduced capability. Required delegation remains unsatisfied, never independent review by assertion.\\n\\nBe scientific. Every shipped line traces to runtime evidence. Belt-and-suspenders that \\\"might help\\\" is a hypothesis, not a fix. It does not ship. When evidence refutes a hypothesis, revert what it motivated. The smallest change the evidence justifies ships, nothing more.\\n\\n1. Reproduce it yourself on the matching surface via the control skill in the mode's Non-negotiables, even when a debug or instrumentation protocol says to ask the user to reproduce. Ask the user only with a stated, specific reason the control surface cannot reach the target, and only after driving it as far as it goes. If it won't reproduce directly, synthesize the trigger, tighten conditions, or instrument until it fires. Record the exact symptom, trigger, surface, revision, command or action, exit status where available, and output before changing production code. Missing control companions or denied execution leave the original reproduction unverified. A proxy check cannot satisfy the matching-surface gate.\\n2. Binary-search the cause. Form candidate hypotheses, then rule them out until one survives. Seed them with [how](../../how/SKILL.md) over the affected subsystem and [why](../../why/SKILL.md) for regression history, using their complete prompts and source contracts. Each pass takes the split that cuts the most remaining problem space, gets runtime evidence and eliminates candidates. When program state is unclear, add authorized instrumentation or logging and read it as the code runs. Don't guess. Drive a long or stubborn hunt with an exposed, authorized repeated-execution operation. If unavailable, perform bounded in-session iterations and disclose reduced capability, without claiming a background loop. Confirm the surviving mechanism with runtime evidence before the step-3 architect/interrogate fan-out.\\n3. Plan the fix. If it crosses a function boundary, [architect](../../architect/SKILL.md) first, using its complete exploration, runner, rationale and screening contracts. Contested design follows the mode's [interrogate](../../interrogate/SKILL.md) gate. Delegate implementation to a subagent using the configured bug-fix role with a specific scope. The portable default is inherited model and effort. The canonical default `grok-4.7-xhigh-fast` is historical provenance, not current availability. Select a configured model only when supported by exposed tools and observed; retain rejected selections and disclosed fallbacks. Unknown actual models prove no diversity. No required independent operation means that gate remains blocked.\\n4. Verify on the same surface. The original repro now passes. Retain the same trigger and conditions and record the actual output after the bounded root-cause fix. \\\"Inconclusive\\\" or wrong-surface is not a pass. Flag it. Unit tests show branch behavior, not bug absence. Keep denied controls, missing companions and unrun checks explicit.\\n5. Stage the commits so the failing repro lands before the fix in git history. See [tdd](../../tdd/SKILL.md) for the failing-test-first cadence when the bug has a cheap local test path. Skip adding that test when it would be expensive, integration-heavy or unclear, and state the reason and closest executable regression check. This is the canonical [sequence-verifiable-units](../../principle-sequence-verifiable-units/SKILL.md) principle skill, the failing test first and the fix on top. Commits, rebases and history changes require actual authorization and available operations. Without them, preserve the failing-before/passing-after artifacts and ordered delivery plan; do not claim that sequence landed.\\n6. Run [Opening a PR](opening-a-pr.md) in full when its dependency and required capabilities are available and authorized. Missing playbook or companion gates stop dependent delivery. Return checked local artifacts and the exact unperformed actions otherwise. PR creation and other external writes require explicit authorization. Opening a PR does not implicitly start Babysit.\\n\\n**Reply:** what was broken, root cause, fix, how you verified. Paste failing-then-passing repro output verbatim. If either observation is missing, state the specific gate and retain the available output without inventing a transcript. Report missing capabilities, unsatisfied delegation or companion gates, deferred delivery and the next maintainer's regression check. Apply the local [unslop](../../unslop/SKILL.md) contract.\\n### Perf issue\\n\\nYou own the measurement story. Plan, review, verify the numbers. Tie every fix to a measurement, don't read source instead of measuring.\\n\\nRead the complete [poteto mode](../SKILL.md) and required leaves. Use [session capabilities](../../../references/host-capabilities.md), [model roles](../../../references/model-roles.md), the [assignment contract](../../../references/orchestration-contract.md) and the full [poteto role prompt](../../../references/agent-prompts/poteto-agent.md). Record actual exposed controls, execution and artifact access before using them. Missing required reads stop dependent work. Do not install controls or profilers implicitly.\\n\\n1. Capture a baseline trace via the matching control skill. Discover the actual control-cli or control-ui companion and its exposed tools for the measured CLI, UI or runtime. Missing or denied matching controls leave capture blocked. Reviewing supplied traces is a reduced assessment and does not prove a new capture. Vet the baseline, and each later number, with the complete [benchmark-checklist](../../benchmark-checklist/SKILL.md) and its [explain-the-number](../../principle-explain-the-number/SKILL.md) contract. Record the exact baseline and treatment revisions, workload, data size, concurrency, timed region, configuration, tuning, cache state, warmup, sample count, errors and completed work. Keep comparable runs and their artifacts. A choice between fixes is not the checklist's one-run ballpark exception.\\n2. Run [how](../../how/SKILL.md) to ground hypotheses. Don't claim a perf ceiling without running it first.\\n   Try the performance mantras in order, cheapest first:\\n   1. Don't do it. Stop work whose result nothing uses rather than cheapening it.\\n   2. Do it, but don't do it again.\\n   3. Do it less.\\n   4. Do it later.\\n   5. Do it when they're not looking.\\n   6. Do it concurrently.\\n   7. Do it cheaper.\\n\\n   When an earlier mantra meets the target, stop.\\n3. Plan the fix from the trace. If it crosses a function boundary, run the complete [architect](../../architect/SKILL.md) workflow first, including its runner prompts, candidate screening and rationale. Delegate implementation to an authorized independent worker with the complete poteto role prompt, an exact input revision and distinct owned output. Use the configured perf-issue role only when its model and effort are supported by current exposed operations. Otherwise request inherited selection and disclose rejected or unavailable selections. Record requested and observed values separately; unknown observed values prove no model diversity. If the exact selection is required but unavailable, block it. Inspect the returned artifacts and review the diff. Without authorized workers, perform authorized sequential implementation as reduced capability; independent delegation remains unsatisfied. Capture a post-fix trace on the matching measured system and vet it with the same checklist.\\n   Apply [sequence-verifiable-units](../../principle-sequence-verifiable-units/SKILL.md), verifying each attempt before trying the next. An unavailable check blocks advancement and stays unverified.\\n4. Parse and compare the artifacts, including JSON to sqlite and a diff when applicable, using available authorized execution and storage. Retain original traces and the comparison artifact. Apply all seven checklist questions. For a comparison, run each side at least five times, alternate the sides, report median and range, and treat a gap smaller than variation as no measurable difference. Keep profiling runs separate from reported timings. Name the limiter from run evidence, check physical limits, production tuning, correct outputs, error counts, actual completed work and end-to-end relevance. \\\"Inconclusive\\\" or wrong-surface is not a pass. Flag it. Missing limiter, an untuned side, or unchecked errors or completed work makes a claimed difference inconclusive. Incompatible workloads, revisions or configurations cannot support the proposed performance claim.\\n5. Cite the measurement in the PR. Keep one primary number with its unit in the body and link the runs, range, limiter and trace comparison artifact. Prepare a local draft when PR writes are unauthorized; do not claim that draft is a created PR.\\n6. Run the complete [Opening a PR](opening-a-pr.md) playbook only within actual authorization and exposed capabilities. Rebase, commit, external writes and PR creation each retain their permission gates. Missing delivery dependencies stop delivery-dependent work. Opening a PR does not start Babysit.\\n\\nFor sustained improvement against a metric rather than a one-off fix, use the [Hillclimb](hillclimb.md) playbook. Preserve this playbook's earlier-mantra stop rule for the one-off fix. Hillclimb and Opening a PR remain pending companion dependencies for tasks 18 and 21, with task 24 integration.\\n\\nReply with the baseline number, post-fix number, delta and artifact path. Include units and the checklist verdict, sample count, range and limiter with the evidence. Name unavailable measurements or unperformed actions instead of inventing numbers or artifacts.\\n### Hillclimb\\n\\nYou own the metric and the experiment's integrity. Supervise and review. Delegate the attempts. For sustained, iterative improvement of one measurable thing against a target. A one-off fix is Bug fix or Perf issue. This is the loop.\\n\\nRead the complete [poteto mode](../SKILL.md), applied leaves and their referenced contracts. Use [session capabilities](../../../references/host-capabilities.md), [model roles](../../../references/model-roles.md), the [assignment contract](../../../references/orchestration-contract.md) and full [poteto role prompt](../../../references/agent-prompts/poteto-agent.md). Preserve the active workflow owner. Record actual execution, file, worker and persistence bindings and permissions. Missing required reads stop dependent work. Do not install companions or set up scheduling implicitly.\\n\\nCore discipline is one change, one measurement, keep or revert. Never stack untested changes, and never claim a win from code inspection. Apply [prove-it-works](../../principle-prove-it-works/SKILL.md).\\n\\n1. Ground the workload and architecture before choosing the metric. Run the complete [how](../../how/SKILL.md) skill over the target, including its explorer and explainer prompts as applicable. Name realistic workload dimensions that can move the result, including data size, history, state and concurrency. Select a case that reproduces the user's complaint. If none reproduces it, fix the repro instead of hillclimbing. Fix one metric, its unit and direction of improvement, and a checkable stop predicate pairing a target with a floor on attempts so a lucky early win cannot end the run. The source example is at least 50% better than baseline and at least 10 iterations. Use the user's numbers when given, otherwise agree them before the loop.\\n2. Build the measurement harness, prove its sensitivity, then freeze it. Apply [build-the-lever](../../principle-build-the-lever/SKILL.md). Run contrasting realistic workloads and confirm the target reproduces the symptom while easier cases separate as expected. If it cannot distinguish them, revise the workload or metric. Vet it with the complete [benchmark-checklist](../../benchmark-checklist/SKILL.md) and [explain-the-number](../../principle-explain-the-number/SKILL.md) before freezing. Print error counts and completed-work counts. One repeatable command emits the same metric with enough samples to clear noise. For performance comparisons, alternate at least five runs per side and report median and range, with production tuning, limiter, correct outputs and end-to-end relevance. Record exact revisions, workload and configuration with each run. Record the baseline metric and a green regression gate before any change. Denied execution or missing measurement artifacts blocks new measurement claims.\\n3. Open the decision log via the complete [show-me-your-work](../../show-me-your-work/SKILL.md) skill and its [log helper](../../show-me-your-work/scripts/log.sh). Keep the canonical trail at an explicit owned, gitignored `decision.tsv` path outside committed changes. Use that skill's TSV format and append-only helper, not a second schema. One row per attempt records the source's id, hypothesis, change, before, after, delta, tests, kept or reverted verdict and note through its decision, why, evidence and result cells. Link an owned per-attempt artifact when the details do not fit single-line cells. Read the trail before each attempt and follow its pickup, transcript audit and cross-model review rules. Verify saved records by readback. Unavailable persistence or helper execution stays a visible block, not a claimed log.\\n4. Ground each hypothesis in step 1's architecture model so it names a specific mechanism, such as deferring work off the boot path because it blocks first paint. For a perf metric, order hypotheses by step 2's performance mantras in [Perf issue](perf-issue.md). Borrow only their order, not that step's stop rule.\\n5. Loop with one hypothesis per iteration:\\n   - Hand the change to an authorized independent worker with tight scope, exact input SHA, distinct owned output and the entire poteto role prompt. Use the configured hillclimb model only when current exposed operations support its model and effort. Otherwise request inherited selection and disclose rejected or unavailable configuration. Record requested and observed values separately; unknown actual models prove no diversity. An unavailable exact required selection blocks dispatch. Supervise and review the diff under [guard-the-context-window](../../principle-guard-the-context-window/SKILL.md). Several independent hypotheses may run in parallel only with authorized workers and separate worktrees under [separate-before-serializing-shared-state](../../principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state/SKILL.md). Measure each isolated candidate against the same frozen harness and base. Integrate only reviewed, verified changes. Without workers, authorized sequential attempts are reduced capability and leave independent delegation unsatisfied.\\n   - Measure before and after with the frozen harness and run the regression gate. Keep the workload, metric and configuration comparable. Reject an inconclusive, error-producing or skipped-work result. A gap smaller than variation is no measurable difference.\\n   - Accept only when the metric moves past noise and the gate stays green. Otherwise revert the attempt's change in full while preserving unrelated work. A tweak that might help is not kept. Do not stack unverified changes or start the next attempt when a required check is unavailable.\\n   - Make one commit per accepted fix only when authorized, staging exact owned changed files, never all files. If commit permission is absent, retain verified local changes as a reduced result and report the delivery block. Log every attempt, kept or reverted, with its evidence.\\n\\n   Each iteration ends in a check before the next begins under [sequence-verifiable-units](../../principle-sequence-verifiable-units/SKILL.md). For unattended runs, borrow only the wake mechanism from [Autonomous run](autonomous-run.md), never its stop rule. Require that complete companion, actual exposed wake controls and explicit scheduling authorization before claiming unattended execution. Without them, remain in an authorized foreground run and disclose the limit.\\n6. Push past the first plateau. On a stall or several rejects in a row, pivot category, combine near-misses as a new single measured hypothesis, re-read the source or try something more radical before concluding. Correctness and simplicity outrank the number. Revert a win that breaks behavior, and keep a simplification that holds the number under [laziness-protocol](../../principle-laziness-protocol/SKILL.md).\\n7. Stop when the predicate is met, or when remaining ideas are marginal and not worth their cost. Do not relax the predicate to meet it or quit while cheap untried hypotheses remain. If stuck, surface it instead of spinning. Report a cost-based stop or blocker separately from meeting the target and iteration floor.\\n8. Run the complete [Opening a PR](opening-a-pr.md) with accepted commits stacked in landing order, within actual commit, rebase and external-write authorization. Missing delivery dependencies stop delivery-dependent work. Without PR-write authorization prepare a local draft and report the unperformed action. Opening a PR does not start Babysit.\\n\\nReply with the metric and target, baseline to final with calculated percent delta, iterations run with kept and reverted counts, each accepted fix on one line, the actual `decision.tsv` path, and the best next idea if pushed further. Include the stop reason, measurement limits and unperformed delivery steps. A zero or invalid baseline cannot support a percent claim. Preserve show-me-your-work's Attention section and observed reviewer model or explicit review block. Autonomous run and Opening a PR are pending companion dependencies for tasks 20 and 21, closed through task 24 integration. Structural checks prove no host execution or improvement.\\n### Runtime forensics\\n\\nYou own the diagnosis. Instrument the live process, don't theorize from source. The deliverable is a cited diagnosis, not a fix.\\n\\nRead the complete [poteto mode](../SKILL.md), [session capabilities](../../../references/host-capabilities.md), [model roles](../../../references/model-roles.md), [assignment contract](../../../references/orchestration-contract.md) and [poteto role prompt](../../../references/agent-prompts/poteto-agent.md). Discover the matching control-cli or control-ui companion and actual exposed capture, artifact-access and live instrumentation operations. Record successful operations separately from exposed tools. Do not install controls or profilers implicitly. Missing required reads stop dependent work.\\n\\n1. Capture the live signal on the matching surface via the control skill. Use a CPU profile for a spinning process, a heap snapshot for a leak, or a CDP trace for a visual glitch. Retain the real artifact and identify the observed process, workload and capture context. Source inspection does not replace runtime evidence. Missing controls, denied execution or inaccessible telemetry block new capture. Authorized inspection of a supplied trace is reduced capability and does not prove live capture or live mechanism confirmation.\\n2. Reduce the artifact to the function on the hot path, the retainer chain from the leaked object to a GC root, or the loop firing without input. Parse large artifacts in an authorized independent worker under the complete [guard-the-context-window](../../principle-guard-the-context-window/SKILL.md) contract. Supply the full poteto prompt, exact input revision and distinct owned output. Inspect the returned finding and cite the original artifact locations that support it. Keep only the reduced finding in the main thread. Use inherited model roles unless supported selection is observed; record requested and actual values separately. Without authorized workers, use bounded sequential parsing as reduced capability and leave independence unmet. Inaccessible artifacts stay unread and unverified.\\n3. Prove the mechanism before believing it. Inject instrumentation via an exposed CDP eval operation on the running process, or hotfix the live code without reloading, only with authorization and the matching live controls. Record the intervention and observed result against the captured symptom. These diagnostic interventions are mutations despite the read-only deliverable; read-only permission does not authorize them. Without authorized live intervention, keep the proposed mechanism provisional and the proof gate blocked. A source hypothesis or supplied trace alone is not live confirmation.\\n4. Map the finding back to source. Cite the file, symbol and line that allocates or schedules, alongside the runtime artifact evidence. If source mapping is unavailable, state that gap instead of inventing a location.\\n5. Throughput checkpoint stays one line: `throughput checkpoint: n/a, read-only forensics`.\\n\\nReply with the signal captured, the reduced finding, how you proved the mechanism, the source location and artifact paths. Cite only accessible evidence and distinguish observed findings from provisional hypotheses and absent telemetry. No fix unless asked. Hand back to [Bug fix](bug-fix.md) or [Perf issue](perf-issue.md) once the cause is known; diagnosis does not authorize implementation.\\n### Trace forensics\\n\\nYou own the diagnosis from the artifact. Load it, shape it, narrow to the cause, attribute to source.\\n\\nDistinct from [Runtime forensics](runtime-forensics.md), which instruments the live process. Here the capture already exists. The artifact is a fixed dataset. Read it, don't re-run it. Keep tooling generic so the playbook stays portable. Use an available DevTools or trace parser for cpuprofile and `.json.gz`, a text editor for a spindump, and heap tooling for a heapsnapshot.\\n\\nRead the complete [poteto mode](../SKILL.md), [session capabilities](../../../references/host-capabilities.md), [model roles](../../../references/model-roles.md), [assignment contract](../../../references/orchestration-contract.md) and [poteto role prompt](../../../references/agent-prompts/poteto-agent.md). Discover actual artifact-read, parser, execution and local storage operations. Use only authorized operations and output paths. Missing required reads stop dependent work. Do not install a parser or upload an artifact implicitly.\\n\\n1. Identify the format and load it with the right available tool. Retain the exact artifact identity and path, format and capture metadata it actually carries. Preserve the original bytes. Parse large artifacts in an authorized independent worker under the complete [guard-the-context-window](../../principle-guard-the-context-window/SKILL.md) contract and keep the reduced finding in the main thread. Supply the full poteto prompt, exact input revision and distinct owned output. Inspect the result and its artifact citations. Use inherited model roles unless selection is supported and observed; record requested and actual values separately. Without authorized workers, use bounded sequential parsing as reduced capability. Missing artifact access or a suitable parser blocks dependent analysis, never an invented read.\\n2. Transform the raw artifact into a form you can query. Dump the trace or heap snapshot into sqlite, one row per sample, frame, or node. Reach the queryable shape before you read for diagnosis. Preserve original sample or event order, timestamps, frame or node identities, parent or retainer relationships and links back to the original artifact locations. Derived data must identify its source artifact. Write the derived database only to an authorized local output. If sqlite conversion or storage is unavailable or denied, disclose the missing gate. An available read-only queryable representation is reduced capability and does not prove the sqlite dump ran.\\n3. Narrow to the cause. Query for the frames that hold the most time and walk the call tree to the hot path. For a leak, follow the retainer chain from the leaked object to a GC root. For a spindump, find the thread stuck on-CPU or blocked and its wait reason. Cite the exact artifact records supporting the reduced finding. Do not substitute a new capture or reconstructed event order.\\n4. Attribute to source. Map the hot frame to file, symbol, and line via the artifact's own symbols. A frame with no source mapping is not yet a diagnosis. Resolve the symbols with available authorized tools, or say plainly the artifact does not carry them. Keep artifact and source citations together. Verify each PR independently, land only the verified run from the root, then keep your hands off the queue.**\\n\\nThis is the half after [babysit](babysit.md). It owns requests to land or ship. A verified PR sitting above an unverified one is not landable. A rebase or base retarget rewrites SHAs and can silently invalidate a verdict without touching a check. Re-read the head and base immediately before the authorized merge or arm action. If either moved since the freshness check, stop and repeat that check. When the two patches differ only in tests, docs, or lint config, build what each lane ran. Build it twice at the verdict SHA and once at the current head. A difference is noise if the two builds at the verdict SHA also show it, or if it is an embedded commit SHA. Judge each difference, not each file, and report each kind of noise with its files. If only noise differs, that lane's result stays valid, and checks and a review of the change run fresh. Do not reuse a lane result from a dev server or from anything else with no build output. Rerun that lane. Re-verify anything else when the patch changed. When it did not, keep the code verdict but re-run mergeability and CI at the current head. Never use matching commit messages or a green check from an older SHA as a substitute.\\n4. **Prepare only the bottom PR.** Fetch current trunk. Rebase the lowest verified branch onto the exact trunk tip when needed, push it, and retarget only that PR to trunk through an exposed built-in PR tool when present, as required by [opening a PR](opening-a-pr.md). Without that tool use `origin pr edit <pr> --base <trunk>` or `gh pr edit <pr> --base <trunk>`. Re-run step 3 after the push. Do not retarget, arm, or merge descendants yet.\\n5. **Land one PR at a time.** If the bottom PR is mergeable now, squash it with `origin pr merge <pr> --squash` or `gh pr merge <pr> --squash`. If requirements are still running and the user asked for merge-when-ready, arm only that PR with `origin pr merge <pr> --squash --auto` or `gh pr merge <pr> --squash --auto`. Origin's `--auto` is Origin merge-when-ready. GitHub's `--auto` is GitHub auto-merge. It does not prove Origin merge-when-ready is armed, that a descendant is queued, that a patch verdict is current, or that the contiguous stack is safe. Confirm the active forge's state for the current bottom PR, and say that the state is unknown if the active forge cannot report it.\\n7. **Recompute after every merge.** Fetch trunk, confirm the merged SHA is present, drop the merged PR from the frozen bottom-to-top list, and inspect the new bottom PR's base, head, checks, and patch-id. A host may retarget a child automatically, but do not assume it did. Repeat steps 3 through 6 for that one PR. Independent work stays outside this chain and ships on its own.\\n8. **Watch the current frontier until it merges or fails. Do not mutate the queue around it.** With Origin, use `origin pr view <pr> --checks --comments` and `origin pr checks <pr> --watch`, then re-read the PR until it reports merged or blocked. With GitHub, use the read-only [watcher](../scripts/watch-pr/watch-pr) from the package root as `bun --no-install skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/watch-pr --owner <owner> --repo <repo> --queued-stack --stack-prs <bottom> --head <bottom=full-40-character-head> --max-polls <remaining-count> --timeout <remaining-seconds>` only as an event wake and poll `gh pr view <pr> --json state,mergedAt,mergeStateStatus,statusCheckRollup,autoMergeRequest` after each wake, ignoring `READY` until `mergedAt` is non-null or `state` is `MERGED`. Only then run step 7. Hard-fail only when `state` is `CLOSED` with no `mergedAt`, a required check concludes `FAILURE` or `CANCELLED` and blocks merge after auto-merge is no longer pending, or `mergeStateStatus` is `UNSTABLE` or `DIRTY` with no auto-merge pending. `BLOCKED` while checks are pending or auto-merge is armed is not failure. Do not use Babysit's queued `WAITING`/`merge-queue` stop condition here. Hold the watch through the observed authorized loop or wake binding within the declared budget. Do not add a second sleep loop. The watcher emits NDJSON schemaVersion 1 events. Inspect kind, terminal and reason, never exit 0 alone. Queued mode emits non-terminal `WAITING` with `reason.kind` equal to `merge-queue`, not `READY`. Terminal helper blockers or budget exhaustion require inspection of the active forge, not an invented merged or hard-failed state. Extending the run is a new pass through step 1.\\n\\n**Reply:** the verified run and its ceiling, each PR's verdict and who produced it, what you armed and how you confirmed it, what landed, and what the next gap needs.\\n\"\n    }\n  },\n  {\n    \"args\": {\n      \"cmd\": \"cat '/Users/digital-hawk/Herd/pstack-host-verification-20261016-51f209d/runtime/plugins/cache/pstack-frozen-verification/pstack-openai/0.1.3/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/autonomous-run.md' '/Users/digital-hawk/Herd/pstack-host-verification-20261016-51f209d/runtime/plugins/cache/pstack-frozen-verification/pstack-openai/0.1.3/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/orchestrate.md' '/Users/digital-hawk/Herd/pstack-host-verification-20261016-51f209d/runtime/plugins/cache/pstack-frozen-verification/pstack-openai/0.1.3/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/autopilot-full.md' '/Users/digital-hawk/Herd/pstack-host-verification-20261016-51f209d/runtime/plugins/cache/pstack-frozen-verification/pstack-openai/0.1.3/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/autopilot-stack.md'\",\n      \"max_output_tokens\": 10000\n    },\n    \"return\": {\n      \"chunk_id\": \"354f81\",\n      \"wall_time_seconds\": 0.000006041,\n      \"exit_code\": 0,\n      \"original_token_count\": 13359,\n      \"output\": \"Warning: truncated output (original token count: 13359)\\nTotal output lines: 196\\n\\n### Autonomous run\\n\\nOwn the exit condition within the authorized scope. Define done, then drive to it while execution is available. This is the playbook for \\\"run until done\\\" and \\\"/loop until X\\\". The source's /loop was a host built-in, not a pstack skill or a portable tool binding.\\n\\nRead [poteto-mode](../SKILL.md) in full. Discover actual operations through [session capabilities](../../../references/host-capabilities.md) and follow the [assignment contract](../../../references/orchestration-contract.md). Upstream autonomy does not override user gates or host permissions.\\n\\n1. State the exit condition as a checkable predicate before the first iteration, such as tests green, repro fixed, all N PRs merged or pixel-diff zero. Record the check and its current evidence. A merge predicate does not authorize merging.\\n2. Pick an exposed, authorized wake mechanism and observe its registration before claiming it active. An event to watch, such as CI, a merge or a ref advancing, gets an independent watcher worker with a long time-based heartbeat as fallback. No event gets a fixed-interval heartbeat sized to when the result is worth re-checking. Use the [poteto role prompt](../../../references/agent-prompts/poteto-agent.md), exact assignment revision and isolated outputs for a watcher. Follow [model roles](../../../references/model-roles.md), defaulting to inherit-parent and recording actual models only when observed. Record missing or failed wake, heartbeat, worker and stop/control bindings separately. Never install or schedule implicitly. If persistent wake is unavailable, continue useful authorized iterations in the current turn and save the continuation brief below before returning. Label this reduced capability, without a promise of work after the turn. A foreground check is not an independent watcher. If control is unavailable, disclose that limit and do not claim a worker stopped or unattended recovery is safe.\\n3. Each iteration makes the smallest change the evidence justifies and verifies it against the predicate. Commit if it advanced and commit authorization and review gates are satisfied. Otherwise keep the verified change local and report the unmet gate. Discard changes that did not help, reverting only this run's owned changes. Revert speculative fixes that merely \\\"might help\\\". Sequence work through [sequence-verifiable-units](../../principle-sequence-verifiable-units/SKILL.md), verifying each unit before the next instead of batching checks at the end. Missing verification blocks dependent advancement.\\n4. Address mid-run broken skills, related bugs, flaky verifiers, review noise, tooling failures, orphaned follow-ups and fixable drift through poteto-mode within authorization. Put out-of-band fixes in their own PR when PR creation is authorized, using the mode's Opening a PR route. Otherwise prepare the separate local fix and disclose the unperformed PR action. Do not park authorized reversible work for the human or ask a question an experiment can settle. Surface irreversible actions, explicit operator gates, genuine product or preference calls no experiment can settle, or a real dead end. Stop dependent work on a broken contract, continue independent work, and return to the main predicate after each side fix.\\n5. Checkpoint every iteration through [show-me-your-work](../../show-me-your-work/SKILL.md), with what changed and whether the predicate moved. Use its [log helper](../../show-me-your-work/scripts/log.sh) through authorized execution with an explicit owned local log path and its [template](../../show-me-your-work/references/decision-log-template.tsv). Keep append-only history, read back saved records, audit against this run's available transcript and preserve its cross-model review and Attention requirements. Missing history, persistence or independent review remains visible. A saved log does not prove unattended execution.\\n6. Stop successfully only when the predicate is met. A plateau is not completion. Keep going and pivot while authorization and execution permit. Surface a genuine dead end instead of spinning and never relax the predicate to declare victory. A session boundary, unavailable persistent tool or explicit pause requires a handoff with the predicate still open, not a completion claim.\\n\\nWhen ongoing work cannot survive the turn, save a continuation brief at an explicit authorized local path and read it back. Include the unchanged exit predicate and current state, iterations completed, current revision and owned changes, verification commands and results, decision-log path, accepted and discarded changes, outstanding gates and missing capabilities, pending action identities and known outcomes, and the next check or experiment. A new run must inspect current state and permissions before continuing or replaying an action. Unknown external outcomes block replay. If local persistence is denied or unavailable, return the brief inline and state that no durable save occurred. Neither form registers a wake mechanism or proves automatic pickup.\\n\\nReply with the exit condition, iterations run, what landed, what was discarded and final predicate state. Distinguish verified local work from actual commits, PRs and merges. Link the saved trail and continuation brief only after readback. Report missing capabilities, blocked gates and any unperformed action. Keep show-me-your-work's Attention section when a trail was produced.\\n### Orchestrate\\n\\nRead [poteto-mode](../SKILL.md), [capabilities](../../../references/host-capabilities.md), [model roles](../../../references/model-roles.md), [assignment contract](../../../references/orchestration-contract.md), [workflow ownership](../../../references/workflow-ownership.md), and the [poteto role prompt](../../../references/agent-prompts/poteto-agent.md) in full. This playbook responds to \\\"run this whole project\\\" and \\\"own this migration until it lands\\\". Aliases do not register host commands. Read applied principles and routed skills before dependent work. Use [arena](../../arena/SKILL.md), [figure-it-out](../../figure-it-out/SKILL.md), [show-me-your-work](../../show-me-your-work/SKILL.md), [separate shared state](../../principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state/SKILL.md), and [encode lessons](../../principle-encode-lessons-in-structure/SKILL.md) where the steps call for them. Apply [unslop](../../unslop/SKILL.md) to briefs and reports.\\n\\nA program needs observed independent worker operations, isolated ownership, execution, persistence and result inspection. Without workers, authorized sequential work is reduced capability and cannot satisfy a required independent review or standing program. Without execution or writable persistence, block helper-dependent work and offer a scoped read-only handoff. Missing wake or remote placement means foreground operation only. Recurring wakes need explicit scheduling authorization. No unattended continuity is implied. Commits, pushes, PR creation, merges, messages, deployments, deletion and setup each retain their applicable permission gates. Gate defaults never grant permission by silence.\\n\\nThe companion wake mechanism is a host capability, not a bundled loop skill. Pending caller paths are `playbooks/autonomous-run.md` and `playbooks/babysit.md`. Stop dependent routes that need those instructions until they exist. The embedded small-task collapse in Frame remains usable without the Autonomous run document. Never install missing companions implicitly.\\n\\n**You own the program, never the code. Author briefs, drain the queue, keep the frontier green, decide.** For a whole project handed to one standing coordinator chat: multi-day, many stacked PRs, dozens to hundreds of subagents, the human checking in twice a day instead of every five minutes. One task driven to a predicate is Autonomous run. One ambitious run needing a bespoke workflow is figure-it-out. Route here when the work outlives any single agent. Work one agent could finish inside the session's budget is not a program.\\n\\nCeremony must scale with the program. On cheap near-identical units, collapse it as each section directs.\\n\\nThe following rules govern the program.\\n\\n- Completions are queue events, not interrupts.\\n- Every spawn and every resume carries the standing orders verbatim.\\n- The brief is the product. A vague brief fails quietly, because a worker cannot ask you a question.\\n\\n#### Roles and placement\\n\\n- **Coordinator (this chat).** Local. Frames, authors briefs, drains the inbox, owns the human report, makes judgment calls. It never authors or edits code. Conflicted merges, restacks, and code changes are always tasks. Mechanically landing a verified unit (fast-forward or clean cherry-pick of a worker's commit, then push) is bookkeeping the coordinator may do itself on repos where local git is cheap. Queueing finished work behind an idle stacker is how a deadline harvests nothing. Bind spawn, follow-up, wait, result inspection and stop to exposed authorized operations. State reads and writes go through the bookkeeping helper at drain points. Most compact outputs are bounded summaries; inbox drain returns all pointers, status returns three lines, and `--json` returns complete rows. The CLI never spawns, waits, or wakes anything.\\n- **Sub-coordinator.** Always local, durable, one per track, and only when the program exceeds what one coordinator's drains can manage. A track the coordinator can drain itself needs no middle layer. Each nested layer re-pays a full orientation preamble, and a blocking sub-coordinator hides its children while the parent idles. Owns its track's units and boards, authors its workers' briefs, spawns its own workers and verifiers only when nesting and isolation are exposed and observed. Depth 3 is the desired ceiling, not a portable runtime guarantee. Rolls up aggregates at wave boundaries. Never forwards raw child reports. Cap in-flight children at what one drain can process, roughly ten, as a rolling window. Never as blocking batches, which cost the slowest child of every batch.\\n- **Worker / verifier.** Prefer remote workers when exposed and authorized. Local-only verification, this run's accessible transcripts, simulators, local IDE state and local auth require a suitable local binding. Discover control-ui and control-cli companions rather than assuming them. Remote workers cannot be assumed to read the local store, so inline required context or use paths confirmed readable by that worker. Prefer fewer, broader workers. One writer per worktree or branch (principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state). Prefer a verifier on a different observed model family. Inherit the parent selection unless explicit supported selection is observed. Unknown actual models leave diversity unverified; an unavailable required family blocks that gate.\\n\\nDepth stays at coordinator, track, worker. Author the track decomposition per project (build, landing, and verification are common cuts, not a required shape). Hard-coded swarm trees were tried and parked as too rigid.\\n\\n#### Store layout\\n\\nChoose an explicitly authorized task-owned writable `orchestrate/<project-slug>/` outside the package tree. Every file has exactly one writer. Owners publish facts, readers aggregate at read time. Use `bun --no-install <package-root>/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/orch.ts --store <owned-store>`, written below as `orch`. `ORCH_STORE` is the alternative explicit binding. Plain TSV and JSON stay readable without the CLI.\\n\\n- `preferences.md` is the standing-orders register: numbered lines, one constraint each (model policy, stack shape and count, verification bar, forbidden paths, escalation policy). Paste it verbatim into every spawn and every resume. Directives decay across resumes, and each dropped one costs a human turn. When you catch yourself restating an instruction, append the line before you act (principle-encode-lessons-in-structure).\\n- `overview.md` is the durable PR and issue DB. Append. Never rewrite wholesale per event.\\n- `units.tsv` has one row per unit: id, track, state, branch, PR, head SHA, brief path. Update rows in place.\\n- `frontier.json` is the computed merge frontier, per Stack safety.\\n- `ledger.tsv` is the verification ledger, per Verification.\\n- `inbox/` holds completion pointers. `gates.md` parks human gates (question, options, default on no answer).\\n- `decisions.tsv` is the trail via the show-me-your-work skill.\\n- `status.md` is derived from `units.tsv` and `ledger.tsv` at each drain, never hand-maintained. Regenerate it from the tables instead of narrating events into it.\\n\\n\\n#### Helper contract\\n\\nRead [orch CLI](../scripts/orch/orch.ts), [store](../scripts/orch/store.ts), [tests](../scripts/orch/orch.test.ts), [bootstrap](../scripts/bootstrap.ts), [manifest](../scripts/package.json) and [lock](../scripts/bun.lock). The CLI requires the exact pinned dependencies in a separately authorized writable copy. The operative package has no installed dependencies; the tested helper snapshot is evidence for that snapshot only. No automatic install occurs. Read docs/testing/helper-setup.md for the exact-copy validation boundary and retained historical setup evidence. It grants no installation approval and transfers no historical pass to this caller. Any future setup needs fresh explicit authorization for the exact writable copy, registry, disabled lifecycle scripts and task-owned cache under Herd. Missing dependencies block execution.\\n\\nUse these actual commands through the explicit `orch` binding:\\n\\n- `init`; `standing add <line>`; `standing show --json`. Compact standing output truncates after four rows, so use JSON or read preferences.md to obtain every standing order.\\n- `unit add <id> --track <track> --brief <path>`; `unit set <id> --state <state> --branch <branch> --pr <number> --sha <full-head-sha>`; `unit get <id>`; `unit list --json`.\\n- `ledger record <pr> <full-head-sha> <verdict> --evidence <path> --verifier <identity>`; `ledger check <pr> <full-head-sha>`; `ledger summary`. A missing exact key returns NOT-VERIFIED and exit 2. Usage or runtime failure returns exit 1; success returns 0.\\n- `inbox push <agent> <unit> <status> --report <path>`; `inbox drain --peek --json`; `inbox drain --json`; `inbox count`. Peek before drain, persist that receipt to an owned artifact and read it back. Capture the complete actual drain output to another owned receipt and verify readback before classifying pointers. Drain removes the queued pointers; arrivals between peek and drain can change the actual batch. If the receipt is lost or interruption makes consumption uncertain, reconcile actual artifacts before retrying or updating rows.\\n- `gate park <id> --question <question> --options <options> --default <answer>`; `gate list --json`; `gate resolve <id> --answer <answer>`. Resolve permission gates only from actual authorization.\\n- `frontier set --repo <stack-owner-clone>`, optionally `--prs <bottom-to-top-numbers>`; `frontier show --json`; `status`. Frontier discovery runs local git and gt inspection against that clone. Missing gt metadata, malformed output or pin mismatch is an error, never guessed frontier state.\\n\\nThe helper does not spawn, wait, wake, enforce worker ownership, validate full revision syntax for unit or ledger input, inspect evidence paths, enforce terminal states or verify permissions. Keep immutable assignments and append-only attempts separately under the assignment contract. Match identity, input revision, full current head SHA, artifacts and observed method before accepting results. Ledger counts include historical revisions; filter against the current unit and frontier heads before counting verified completions. A done unit string, ledger label or open-gate count proves no worker completion or authorization. Coordinator-owned bookkeeping may record worker facts; give each worker separate result and receipt paths. Atomic rename is not proof of crash durability or safe adversarial concurrent access.\\n\\n#### The brief\\n\\nYour prompts to agents are your only product, and a sloppy brief compounds into slop across the whole tree. Every spawn carries all of it. A field you cannot fill is a unit you have not scoped yet.\\n\\n```\\nGOAL         one sentence, the outcome, executable by a stranger with no chat access\\nSCOPE        paths this unit may write; paths it may not; its exclusive worktree or branch\\nCONTEXT      pointers to files and PRs; upstream reports pasted in full when this unit\\n             depends on them, because workers cannot see siblings\\nACCEPTANCE   checkable criteria, one per line\\nVERIFY       exact commands or the control-skill path, plus known gotchas\\nTIMEBOX      rough cap on runtime; on expiry, return partial findings and stop rather than run on\\nFORBIDDEN    no gt, no rebase, no force-push, no fixes outside scope, plus unit-specific bans\\nREPORT       status, branch, head SHA, PRs, verdict, what you actually ran, deviations,\\n             suggested follow-ups\\nSTANDING     <preferences.md pasted verbatim>\\n```\\n\\nSize the brief to the unit. A one-command unit gets the template collapsed to a paragraph that still names goal, scope, the verify command, and the report shape. A 4KB scaffold around a two-line edit costs more to write and obey than the edit. A verified readable local standing-orders path may supply the exact text. Paste it verbatim for remote spawns and every resume. Never replace it with a summary.\\n\\nA sub-coordinator brief adds its track boundary and unit list, its spawn budget with supported remote placement and the local exception list, the drain protocol, and the rollup format (per child: name, status, PR, head SHA, verdict, one line, plus track status and frontier delta).\\n\\nA dependency is a context relay, not just ordering. A vague brief fails quietly, because a worker cannot ask you a question.\\n\\n#### Roles and placement\\n\\n- **Coordinator (this chat).** Local. Casual turn or user opts out -> don't.\\n---\\n\\n# Poteto mode\\n\\n## Portable activation and boot\\n\\nExplicit invocation by poteto, /poteto-mode, or a request for this style activates this workflow subject to [workflow ownership](../../references/workflow-ownership.md). Retain the active controller for unqualified follow-ups. Do not replace another controller or run two controllers over one assignment. If both are explicitly requested, clarify ownership before dispatch or writes.\\n\\nBefore any work, read this entire mode, including the Principles index, and the selected playbook in full. Read each applied principle leaf in full this session. A summary does not satisfy these reads. If a required mode, playbook or applied leaf is unavailable, report the exact missing dependency and stop dependent work. Preserve the source metadata and aliases as invocation guidance; they do not register a host mode, icon or custom agent.\\n\\nDiscover operations using [session capabilities](../../references/host-capabilities.md). Follow [assignment and integration](../../references/orchestration-contract.md), [model roles](../../references/model-roles.md) and the [poteto role prompt](../../references/agent-prompts/poteto-agent.md). Observed bindings and user permissions govern execution. Bundled helpers and playbooks supply instructions, not executable host capability. Never install or configure a companion implicitly.\\n\\n## Non-negotiables\\n\\nThe Principles section below grounds every trigger. In your reply, name each principle that shaped a decision and the specific choice it changed. Cite only principles whose leaf SKILL.md you read this session.\\n\\nRemaining triggers:\\n\\n- For a nontrivial change, architecture decision, or \\\"are we sure?\\\", use the **how** skill.\\n- Before using the host's user-question operation on a \\\"which approach\\\", \\\"how should I\\\", or \\\"what should this do\\\" fork, classify it before you ask.\\n\\n  If the answer is a fact you could observe by running something (behavior, timing, layout, output, perf, even whether an eval separates), it is not the human's to answer.\\n\\n  Sketch it via the Prototype playbook (`playbooks/prototype.md`) and let the result decide.\\n\\n  If the task is a read-only Investigation whose deliverable is a cited answer, stay in it and answer from the evidence rather than building a sketch.\\n\\n  Reserve the question for a genuine product or preference call no experiment can settle.\\n\\n  Under a full-autonomy grant, decide a call that the grant covers, act on it, and report it, with no reply word and no offer.\\n\\n  Under the grant, apply a default for a call that only the operator can make.\\n\\n  Report the default with a full explanation, and say in plain words what the operator could tell you to do instead.\\n\\n  The operator answers in their own words.\\n\\n  Never give a shorthand token to type back.\\n\\n  Gates that the operator named and the Always-pause list in Autonomy still need the operator.\\n- For any code, name the data shape first, and choose its organizing structure per **principle-model-the-domain**.\\n- For code crossing a function boundary, use the **architect** skill, parallel design exploration before implementing.\\n- For parallel fan-out, use the **swarm** skill for coverage matrices, races, gauntlets, and exploration partitions. Use **arena** for design or code bakeoffs with base selection and grafting.\\n- For contested design, use the **interrogate** skill (multi-model adversarial) before shipping.\\n- For nontrivial multi-step work, write the throughput checkpoint (Feature step 3).\\n- For any prose surface, use the **unslop** skill. Your reply is a prose surface. Write it per **Writing the reply**. Agent-facing prose also follows the **create-skill** authoring guidance when that companion is exposed. If unavailable, declare the missing companion and use the bundled Authoring or modifying a skill playbook only as an explicit reduced fallback. Do not claim the absent companion ran.\\n- For docs, RFCs, readmes, PR descriptions, or commit messages, use the **technical-writing** skill (`/technical-writing`).\\n- Before commit, use the `deslop` companion from `cursor-team-kit` (`/deslop`) if available. If absent, report the missing gate and obtain an authorized replacement review before claiming it satisfied. Do not install it implicitly.\\n- Before review, use the **no-comments** companion (`/no-comments`) if available. If absent, disclose the missing gate; this mode's Comments rules remain applicable but do not prove that companion ran.\\n- When shipping UI / IDE / CLI, use the matching control skill. `cursor-team-kit` publishes `control-cli` for CLIs and TUIs and `control-ui` for browser, Electron and web UIs.\\n\\n  Discover their availability and the actual exposed control tools.\\n\\n  Missing tools or companions leave the matching verification blocked; an authorized reduced check must name the surface and its limits.\\n\\n  For bug fixes, reproduce first on the same surface yourself.\\n\\n  Hand to the user only under the narrow Bug fix step 1 exception.\\n- When running a benchmark, measuring perf yourself, or reporting a speedup or regression you measured, use the **benchmark-checklist** skill before you report or act on the number.\\n- For any PR-status request, use the **Babysit** playbook (`playbooks/babysit.md`).\\n\\n  Use the bundled routing even if a host companion has a matching description.\\n\\n  That includes \\\"babysit this\\\", \\\"get it green\\\", \\\"address the bugbot comments\\\", and the commonest phrasing, \\\"check on PR X\\\" / \\\"anything outstanding on X\\\".\\n\\n  Never triggered by merely opening a PR.\\n\\n  Declare its mode before polling.\\n\\n  The playbook's step 1 owns the request-to-mode mapping.\\n\\n  Reaching for `drive` inside a phase agent stops that agent finishing its turn.\\n- When asked to land or ship a green stack, use the **Shipping** playbook (`playbooks/shipping.md`). Green is not safe. Nothing gets armed before an independent per-PR verdict, and only the contiguous verified run from the root lands.\\n- When Bugbot or the agentic security review comments, assess it skeptically. They catch real bugs and also file non-issues and nitpicks, so assess each on its merits and dismiss noise with a concrete reason instead of churning code. Triage fix / dismiss / ask per `references/bugbot-triage.md`.\\n- Broken skill mid-task, fix it separately within authorized scope and prepare its own PR when PR creation is authorized. Continue independent work. Stop dependent work and disclose the broken contract instead of silently working around it.\\n- For long, autonomous, or multi-phase work, or any task the user steps away from to review later (\\\"going to bed\\\", \\\"trust it when i'm back\\\", \\\"/loop until X\\\"), keep a decision trail via the **show-me-your-work** skill. Commit it when stakes need an auditable record. Keep it local otherwise.\\n\\n## Principles\\n\\nRead the leaf skill in full for any principle you apply. Each entry names when it applies.\\n\\n**Core**\\n\\n- **Laziness Protocol** (**principle-laziness-protocol**). Refactoring, sizing a diff, or tempted to add abstractions, layers, or signal threading. Bias to deletion and the smallest change that solves the problem.\\n- **Foundational Thinking** (**principle-foundational-thinking**). Before writing logic: core types and data structures, scaffold-vs-feature sequencing, what concurrent actors share.\\n- **Redesign from First Principles** (**principle-redesign-from-first-principles**). Integrating a new requirement into an existing design. Redesign as if it had been foundational from day one.\\n- **Attack the Premise** (**principle-attack-the-premise**). Two or more fixes that share one premise have failed the same gate. Take a census of which actors hold the imbalance before the next fix, then question the premise instead of writing another fix that assumes it.\\n- **Subtract Before You Add** (**principle-subtract-before-you-add**). Sequencing an addition, refactor, or rewrite. Remove dead weight first, then build on the simpler base.\\n- **Minimize Reader Load** (**principle-minimize-reader-load**). Reviewing or shaping code that's hard to trace. Count layers and hidden state, collapse one-caller wrappers, shrink mutable scope.\\n- **Outcome-Oriented Execution** (**principle-outcome-oriented-execution**). Planned rewrites and migrations with explicit phase boundaries. Converge on the target architecture, don't preserve throwaway compatibility states.\\n- **Experience First** (**principle-experience-first**). Product, UX, or feature-scope tradeoffs. Choose user delight over implementation convenience.\\n- **Exhaust the Design Space** (**principle-exhaust-the-design-space**). A novel interaction or architectural decision with no precedent. Build 2-3 competing prototypes and compare before committing.\\n- **Build the Lever** (**principle-build-the-lever**). Any non-trivial work. Build the tool that does or proves it (codemod, script, generator), not by hand. The tool is the artifact a reviewer reruns.\\n\\n**Architecture**\\n\\n- **Model the Domain** (**principle-model-the-domain**). Writing stateful logic, or code that branches a lot or repeats a shape assumption across files. Encode the domain in a structure (state machine, typed model, table or registry, reducer, boundary, the right collection) instead of scattered conditionals.\\n- **Boundary Discipline** (**principle-boundary-discipline**). Wiring validation, error handling, or framework adapters. Guards at system boundaries, trust internal types, keep business logic pure.\\n- **Type System Discipline** (**principle-type-system-discipline**). Designing types or a signature in any typed language. Make illegal states unrepresentable, brand primitives, parse external data at boundaries.\\n- **Make Operations Idempotent** (**principle-make-operations-idempotent**). Designing commands, lifecycle steps, or loops that run amid crashes and retries. Converge to the same end state.\\n- **Migrate Callers Then Delete Legacy APIs** (**principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis**). Introducing a new internal API while old callers exist. Migrate and delete in one wave.\\n- **Separate Before Serializing Shared State** (**principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state**). Concurrent actors might write the same file, branch, key, or object. Eliminate the sharing first.\\n\\n**Verification**\\n\\n- **Prove It Works** (**principle-prove-it-works**). After a task, before declaring done. Verify against the real artifact, not a proxy or \\\"it compiles\\\".\\n- **Fix Root Causes** (**principle-fix-root-causes**). Debugging. Trace each symptom to its root cause, reproduce first, ask why until you reach it.\\n- **Sequence Work into Verifiable Units** (**principle-sequence-verifiable-units**). Multi-step work (sweeps, migrations, runs of similar edits) and how you stack commits and PRs. Break work into small units that each end in a check, verify each before the next, and order delivery so the sequence proves itself.\\n- **Test Behavior, Not Implementation** (**principle-test-behavior-not-implementation**). Writing, changing, or keeping a test. Call the code the way its users do and assert the result against a literal expected value. If the test would still pass when every imported function returns `undefined`, rewrite the assertion or delete the test.\\n- **Explain the Number** (**principle-explain-the-number**). Before you trust, report, or act on a number you measured (a speedup, a regression, a throughput, a latency, or an eval result). Find what limits it, and rule out that it measured something other than the work you think.\\n\\n**Delegation**\\n\\n- **Guard the Context Window** (**principle-guard-the-context-window**). Context fills up: large outputs, long files, repeated reads, fan-out planning. Route bulk to subagents, keep summaries in the main thread.\\n- **Never Block on the Human** (**principle-never-block-on-the-human**). Tempted to ask \\\"should I do X?\\\" on reversible work. Proceed, present the result, let the human course-correct.\\n\\n**Meta**\\n\\n- **Encode Lessons in Structure** (**principle-encode-lessons-in-structure**). You catch yourself writing the same instruction a second time. Encode it as a lint, metadata flag, runtime check, or script instead of more text.\\n\\n## Autonomy\\n\\n**Just do it within authorization.** Proceed with authorized reversible work using exposed tools and granted permissions. Team chat, ticket updates, eval launches and other external actions require explicit authorization. Upstream autonomy language grants no permission. Record external action identity, destination and observed outcome under the assignment contract before replay. Unknown outcomes block replay.\\n\\n**Always pause** for irreversible writes: force-push to shared branches, deploys, data deletion, customer messages.\\n\\n**Session overrides:** \\\"Don't stop\\\" / \\\"going to bed\\\" / \\\"run until done\\\" / \\\"be fully autonomous\\\" mean keep going within the granted scope. They do not override permissions, explicit operator gates or the Always pause list.\\n\\n**No is an acceptable answer.** Asked whether to do something, invited to add scope, or shown an approach, reply with your real judgment. Decline, push back, or say \\\"this doesn't earn its place\\\" when true. A recommendation is a judgment, not a validation. Agreement is not the default, candor over sycophancy.\\n\\n## Subagents\\n\\nUse the [poteto role prompt](../../references/agent-prompts/poteto-agent.md) for any independent worker you spawn inside a playbook step, including code-writing delegates and ad-hoc helpers. /poteto-mode and the poteto-agent role route through this same full-mode read. Supply the entire role prompt and exact file pointers to the exposed worker operation. Generic routing without that prompt and read skips the style contract. Routed skills such as how, why, interrogate, reflect and swarm choose their own roles for diverse review; preserve their roles instead of overriding them with poteto-agent.\\n\\nDefaults for every worker assignment follow the [assignment contract](../../references/orchestration-contract.md). Use independent background execution only when exposed and observed. Do not claim it from a role name or flag. Grant only the operations the scope needs; read-only work retains read-only permissions even when MCP tools exist. Use file pointers rather than inlined bulk context. Record requested and observed model and effort separately under [model roles](../../references/model-roles.md).\\n\\nCode delegates tier by difficulty. Give cross-cutting design, concurrency and subtle algorithms to the strongest available judgment model, even when the implementation instructions are precise. Trivial mechanical edits use an available fast code model. Authorized role configuration from /setup-pstack can override role defaults for feature and refactoring, bug-fix, perf-issue, hillclimb, hardest tasks, judgment and prose, and routed skills. Select only supported models and efforts from current tool documentation or observed enumeration. A missing role line keeps the portable inherit-parent default. A role line of inherit-parent or auto omits explicit model selection. Unsupported configured models or efforts require a disclosed supported fallback, or blocked if that exact choice is required. The source-host named defaults are not portable availability evidence. Unknown observed models leave diversity unverified.\\n\\nWithout an exposed and authorized independent-worker operation, apply the same full-mode and leaf reads sequentially only within authorized scope. Label reduced capability. Sequential roles are not independent workers, independent review, background execution or model diversity. If the playbook requires independence, leave that gate blocked rather than silently waiving it.\\n\\nA worker forbidden to spawn owns its assigned diff directly and returns it to the lead for review separation, as Feature step 4 requires. It never waits on a nested worker or replies \\\"standing by\\\". This exception does not waive the lead's required independent review. Before accepting any result, match assignment identity, exact input revision, full current head SHA, existing artifacts and observed method evidence. Reject stale results and missing artifacts under the assignment contract. Bookkeeping labels cannot satisfy these checks.\\n\\nYou own every subagent's work. Review the diff and write your own summary, don't pass through what it said. A second opinion is the same prompt against a different model. Treat agreement as supporting evidence only after checking independence, the observed models and the underlying artifacts.\\n\\n**Fresh subagents by default.** Give new work to a fresh subagent with consolidated scope, meaning the original brief, every later directive, and the prior agent's report and branch. This holds for a fix round, a follow-up, a retry, and the next queue item. Resume, message, or queue a follow-up on an existing subagent only when the new work strictly needs state that lives in that agent and is costly to move: its local checkout, its uncommitted changes, or a process it still runs, such as a dev server, a simulator, or a babysit watcher. A stop or hold order to a running agent is not reuse. A role such as a PR owner outlives its agent. Once that agent returns, a fresh agent takes the role's next round. Interrupt-chained resumes silently drop directives, so fire a fresh subagent with consolidated scope rather than trusting a \\\"done\\\" summary.\\n\\n## Throughput checkpoint\\n\\nFor nontrivial multi-step work, write these four todo items before fan-out, as required by Feature step 3. Keep an inapplicable dimension with n/a and a reason. Rewrite the checkpoint at phase boundaries and return it with the evidence.\\n\\n- Blocking first steps. Gates run before fan-out.\\n- Independent workstreams. Disjoint files, services or layers parallelize. Shared writes serialize.\\n- Shared mutable state. Default to splitting the target using the separate-before-serializing-shared-state principle leaf. Serialize only for real invariants.\\n- Smallest safe decomposition. If one worker is best, name why.\\n\\nCode-coupled work goes to one owner with the checkpoint inline. That owner fans out after the blocking phase when authorized and supported. Parent-level fan-out is for independent artifacts. Assignment records and bookkeeping do not prove workers ran. Keep decision trails in an explicit owned local output path per show-me-your-work and its log helper contract. Missing helper setup or persistence stays visible; do not invent saved logs or cross-session continuity.\\n\\n## Integrated helper and delivery bindings\\n\\nRead the selected playbook's complete adapted helper and prompt contracts before dependent execution. The 23 bundled playbook routes below and the Bugbot rubric are local instructions. Historical task deferrals in those files are not proof of absence or permission to skip a present contract. Check the actual path. An absent required contract still blocks its dependent step.\\n\\n- Decision trails use [show-me-your-work](../show-me-your-work/SKILL.md), its [template](../show-me-your-work/references/decision-log-template.tsv) and [log helper](../show-me-your-work/scripts/log.sh).\\n\\n  Invoke the helper through authorized execution with exactly `<logfile> <phase> <decision> <why> <evidence> <result>`.\\n\\n  The nonempty logfile is an explicit owned local path.\\n\\n  Tabs, newlines and carriage returns are rejected before writes, and formula-leading cells are quoted.\\n\\n  Read back the trail and retain the skill's scoped transcript audit, cross-model review and Attention requirements.\\n\\n  Append-only logging proves neither unattended execution nor recovery.\\n- Multi-phase plans use [check-plan.mjs](scripts/check-plan.mjs) as `bun --no-install <package-root>/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/check-plan.mjs <plan.md>`.\\n\\n  It takes one positional path and reads without edits.\\n\\n  Exit 2 means usage or unreadable input, 1 means format problems, and 0 means structural success.\\n\\n  Keep capability declarations, live and perf evidence, independent review and exact-head receipts.\\n\\n  It checks pstack plans only.\\n\\n  It never validates another controller's plan, implementation or host behavior.\\n- Orchestrate uses its [complete helper contract](playbooks/orchestrate.md) and the real [CLI](scripts/orch/orch.ts) and [store](scripts/orch/store.ts).\\n\\n  Bind `bun --no-install <package-root>/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/orch.ts --store <owned-store>` or explicit `ORCH_STORE` outside the package tree.\\n\\n  Use full JSON for standing orders and rows.\\n\\n  Preserve `inbox drain --peek --json` and actual drain receipts with durable readback before classification. `ledger check <pr> <full-head-sha>` returns NOT-VERIFIED and exit 2 for a missing key.\\n\\n  Usage or runtime errors exit 1.\\n\\n  Ledger rows replace the same key without enforcing verifier precedence.\\n\\n  The caller owns precedence, append-only attempt history, exact SHA syntax, artifact inspection, terminal states, permissions and current-head filtering.\\n\\n  The helper never spawns, waits or wakes workers.\\n\\n  Stale locks require ownership review, and `--force` requires explicit takeover permission even for a dead holder.\\n\\n  Frontier discovery uses local git and gt in the stack owner's clone and fails on unavailable metadata or pin mismatch.\\n\\n  Do not substitute this binding for the gt-free Autopilot stack workflow.\\n\\n  Atomic rename is not a crash-durability or adversarial-concurrency guarantee.\\n- Babysit and Shipping use the GitHub-specific read-only [watcher](scripts/watch-pr/watch-pr) through their complete playbooks.\\n\\n  From the package root bind `bun --no-install skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/watch-pr` with explicit `--owner`, `--repo`, PR selection, `--head <number=full-40-character-head>` for every watched member, `--max-polls <remaining-count>` and `--timeout <remaining-seconds>`.\\n\\n  Freeze queued order with `--queued-stack --stack-prs <bottom-to-top-list>`.\\n\\n  Connected mode uses `--stack`, mutually exclusive with queued mode. `check` adds `--status-only`.\\n\\n  Inspect NDJSON schemaVersion 1 kind, terminal and reason.\\n\\n  Exit 0 includes status-only and proves no readiness by itself.\\n\\n  Codes 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 64 identify conflicts, threads, checks, timeout, merge gates, query Four layers get you there, one question each: what kind of document is this, how do sentences address the reader, how much does each sentence carry, and can any sentence be read two ways. Apply all four.\\n\\nThree rules sit above the layers:\\n\\n- **Cut every word that does no work.** If the sentence survives without a word, the word goes. \\\"In order to\\\" is \\\"to\\\". \\\"It is important to note that\\\" is nothing.\\n- **Use the short, everyday word.** \\\"Use\\\", not \\\"utilize\\\". \\\"Help\\\", not \\\"facilitate\\\". \\\"Do\\\", not \\\"perform\\\". Longer ones that take their time carry a fact with its condition or consequence.\\n- One thought per sentence does not mean one length per sentence. Split the sentence that carries two thoughts. Not \\\"schema changes can cause issues\\\" but \\\"a column rename fails the build\\\".\\n\\n## Pick the mode first (Diátaxis)\\n\\nOne document, one mode. The learner's success is your job, not theirs. Open by saying what the learner will build, not what they will \\\"learn\\\". Every step produces a visible result, early and often. Tell them what they should see: the expected output, the prompt change, the log line. Cut explanation to one clause and a link. Teaching pauses break the lesson. Stay concrete. Write as \\\"we\\\", in commands: \\\"First, do x. Now, do y.\\\"\\n\\n**How-to: steps to a goal.** Solve a problem a person has, not an operation the machine can perform. Assume competence. Skip teaching. Action only: no digressions, no background, no completeness for its own sake. Link those instead. Allow forks and judgment: \\\"If you want x, do y.\\\" Name the guide by the task: \\\"How to calibrate the radar array\\\", not \\\"Radar array calibration\\\".\\n\\n**Reference: facts for lookup.** Describe. Only describe. No instruction, no persuasion, no opinion. Be dry, complete, and sure. State facts, options, limits, and errors with no hedging. Mirror the structure of the thing described, so code and docs can be navigated together. Put material where readers expect it. Generate from code where possible, so it stays true.\\n\\n**Explanation: understanding and why.** One bounded topic, readable away from the product.       "text": "# Route responses under this run's permissions\n\nThese are coordinator-authored native routing responses after reading the 23 route documents. They are not 23 implemented feature runs, measurements, trace captures, external deliveries or independently reviewed outcomes.\n\n| Supplied-style request | Selected route | Actual response under current scope |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| How does invoice work? | Investigation | Return cited How explanation. No published stack exists. |\n| Resume prior agent. | Session pickup | Need scoped prior trail and current exact head. No unrelated history search authorized. |\n| Pause safely. | Pause safely | Explicit pause only. No pause requested in this batch; do not stop on going-to-bed-keep-going language. |\n| Plan multiple PRs. | Multi-phase or multi-PR plan | Planning only, explicit go before implementation. Available four slots cannot establish ten independent live lanes. Feature checklist was correctly rejected as a plan. |\n| Free disk space. | Worktree and simulator cleanup | Read-only audit can recommend holds. No deletion permission exists and no deletion ran. |\n| Open a PR. | Opening a PR | Prepare local title/body only when useful. Commits, push, creation, readiness and comments remain forbidden. Opening never starts Babysit alone. |\n\nThe 24 principle names, aliases and trigger meanings are preserved verbatim in source-mode.md's Principles section. Only applied leaves actually read are cited as decision influences. This route exercise does not establish all 24 leaf behaviors, source-host loading or any other host's behavior.\n\n# Helper and failure branches\n\nThe original bootstrap exits 1 on missing commander metadata.
